article.headline: Stewart scores 26, Presbyterian beats Radford 80-73
article.description: — Kobe Stewart scored 26 points as Presbyterian beat Radford 80-73 on Saturday night.
article.story: RADFORD, Va. -- — Kobe Stewart scored 26 points as Presbyterian beat Radford 80-73 on Saturday night. Stewart added six rebounds for the Blue Hose (12-17, 5-9 Big South Conference). Kory Mincy added 13 points while shooting 3 for 12 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line while he also had six assists. Carl Parrish had 12 points and shot 3 of 3 from the field and 4 for 4 from the line. The Highlanders (17-12, 7-7) were led by David Early, who posted 22 points and six assists. Radford also got 19 points from Brandon Maclin. Josiah Harris had eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
